test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The area of a triangular park, whose sides are 160 m, 300 m and 340 m, is 4(17)/(22) of the area of a circular park. What is the perimeter (in m) of the circular park (correct to one decimal place)? (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Sides of the triangular park are 160 m, 300 m and 340 m

**Formula used:**

Area of a right angle triangle = 1/2 × h × b

Area of a circle = πr²

Perimeter of a circle = 2πr

**Calculation:**

160, 300, and 340 are Pythagorean Triplets

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f125ca97e9c232b80484d5a0563150d3cb623a8215877ae17d781f8388510c6.png] 

So, area of the traingle = 1/2 × 160 × 300

⇒ 24000 m²

According to the question,

24000 = 105/22 × area of the circular park

Let radius of the circluar park be r

24000 = 105/22 × 22/7 × r²

⇒ 24000/15 = r²

⇒ 1600 = r2

⇒ r = 40

Perimeter of the circular park = 2 × 22/7 × 40

⇒ 1760/7

⇒ 251.4285 ≈ 251.4

**∴ Required answer is 251.4 m**
